text:
Predicates:
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
Teeth(x) ::: x has teeth.
Platypus(x) ::: x is a platypus.
Reptile(x) ::: x is a reptile.
Humans(x) ::: x is a human.
Question:  
Based on the above information, is the following statement true, false, or uncertain? Platypuses are reptiles.

Premises:
Some mammals have teeth ::: ∃x (Mammal(x) ∧ Teeth(x))
Platypuses have no teeth ::: ∀x (Platypus(x) → ¬Teeth(x))
Platypuses are mammals ::: ∀x (Platypus(x) → Mammal(x))
Humans have teeth ::: ∀x (Human(x) → Teeth(x))

Conclusion:
Platypuses are reptiles ::: ?
